hint.label: Cipher

instruction.text: How should you handle your passwords? Select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Simon wrote down all his passwords in his homework book to make sure he won’t forget them. Is that safe?
b: ++No, it is not safe. People can easily look in his homework book.
Yes, because he must write down his passwords somewhere.

atoms.a: How could Simon manage his passwords more securely?
b: ++He can use a password program that securely creates and stores all his passwords.
He should just hide his homework book better.

atoms.a: Romy feels that she has a very secure password, so she uses it for all her devices and accounts. Is that safe?
b: ++No. If her password gets found out, then all her devices and accounts are endangered. It’s not enough to use only one password.
Yes. This way, she doesn’t need to remember multiple passwords.

atoms.a: Someone figured out your password. What should you do?
b: ++I’ll change my password. Passwords need to be secret.
I won’t do anything. It’s not that bad if only one person knows.
